_ceiling_composition: setup and every step at its bound ($0.92, 50.0 min at $1.09/h incl. disk), rounded up to the cent, + the $0.3 teardown reserve
rate_rule: re-quoted live at launch; the launcher derives the session ceiling and timeout from the live rate and refuses if the cap no longer buys the work
covers: stage W of topk_adoption_driver.py on one L40S pod: the steps of plan.json, nothing else
does_not_cover: a D2 search, recovery training or a behavioural probe
a second pod for a failed step without a recorded engineering cause
any spend above the all-in ceiling, cumulative across subruns
_executable_commit_is: the commit the pod checks out; every executed path and record is identical between it and the commit carrying this proposal (tested: test_d2v3_gpu_validation.py)
activation: the maintainer's grant is recorded by writing this record as authorization.json with status GRANTED, granted_utc, granted_by and the live pre-launch checks; until then engineering_campaign_budget.py cannot read a ceiling and the launcher creates nothing
on_ordinary_failure: repair and retry inside this ceiling (AGENTS.md P12.1); a deterministic paid failure is never retried unchanged
